title: Half & Half Boutique:
headline: A mother and her daughter bought an old Buffalo boutique 10 years ago. Now it is a store for all women, and it dresses What She's Made Of on Nov 5.
story: Jen is one of the two owners of Half & Half. For years, she says, the women of Buffalo did not know the store was there for them. It took 10 years to change that. Alexis shows the store. Rebecca from the WNY Women's Foundation ties it to the event: What She's Made Of, Nov 5, Highmark Stadium. This is boutique 2 of 9 in the series. It is not a list of brands and not a shopping ad with no person in it.

Rebecca's four points for this boutique (Nick, 13 Oct): What She's Made Of, a mother and daughter own it, clothes for women of all ages, and the staff's personal shopping and styling. The two styling clips have their own videos now: in this cut they are quick cutaways only.
Loops: L1 “Who is we?” opens 0:00 and closes at 0:05. L2 “What changed?” opens 0:00 and closes at 0:17. Stakes: it took 10 years to change what Buffalo thought this store was.
